description: This file acts as a test runner script for the live-cache regression tests in the project. It imports testing functions and support utilities, checks if testing is enabled, runs regression tests asynchronously, and reports the results via standard output and error streams.

methods.name: runLiveCacheRegression
methods.description: Asynchronously executes live-cache regression tests and returns a result object containing regressions.

methods.name: logLiveCache
methods.description: Logs messages related to live-cache testing, primarily information or skip notices.
